Name: Ohodavi's Portraits for Rasmodia
Author: Nom0ri
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Hrvj6SP/Romanceable-Rasmodia-Logo.png[/img]
[b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][center]New portraits for the lovely Witch Rasmodia![/center]
[/size][/font][/b]Original portraits from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Ohodavi's Anime portrait mod[/url] unfortunately didn't 100% work with Romanceable Rasmodia so with permission of the author I adjusted them to fit in with our witch. I also was never the biggest fan of flowers covering her face so I modified the portraits to fit my tastes better and changed one of the expressions.

Automatically applies the correct portrait version based on the mods you use. Yes, now with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url] support. Additionally inherits portrait configs from Rasmodia Patch for RRRR making it fully compatible without any extra configs. [b]If you're using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]SCA[/url] and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]SCA for SVE[/url], make sure to disable Wizard and/or Magnus from it's configs for the portraits and overlays to work correctly.[/b]

[size=4][b]Config:[/b][/size]
Flower Overlay [i][default: false][/i] - adds the flower overlay based on the original version by Ohodavi to all versions.
